title: Decentralized Planning
definition: Decentralized planning is a development paradigm where the formulation of economic plans, resource allocation, and project implementation are driven from the grassroots level (villages, blocks, and districts) upward rather than imposed by central authorities. It operationalizes participatory governance and democratic federalism.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper II (Polity and Governance - devolution of powers, Panchayati Raj Institutions) and GS Paper III (Indian Economy - inclusive growth, regional disparities, planning mechanisms). Frequently tested via constitutional amendments, committee reports, and spatial economic disparities.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Decentralized Planning.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Indian Planning and Five-Year Plans
Structure of Indian Federalism and Local Government (73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendments)
